dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: I've been raising 3 Slimes. They like to be lifted up in the air and especially enjoy jumping through hoops.

dialogues.speaker: Slime Breeder
dialogues.text: They go faster when you use Acting Grand Master Jean's <color=#00E1FFFF>Gale Blade</color> though.\nHow about making the Slimes jump through 10 hoops before time runs out! It'll make them happy! Wanna try?
